protected theorem FormalMultilinearSeries.hasFPowerSeriesOnBall [CompleteSpace F]
    (p : FormalMultilinearSeries 𝕜 E F) (h : 0 < p.radius) :
    HasFPowerSeriesOnBall p.sum p 0 p.radius :=
  { r_le := le_rfl
    r_pos := h
    hasSum := fun hy => by
      rw [zero_add]
      exact p.hasSum hy }
